scope: Synthetic numeric-array slice allocation and ownership probe; no production change
method: Create a dense ordinary array of finite nonintegral numbers including negative zero, force garbage collection, slice it, force collection, compare every value, then mutate both arrays and verify independence. This tests a possible shortcut for independently restored ordinary arrays, not the project workflow.
interpretation: In these single synthetic runs slice allocated approximately eight bytes per value, so it does not provide a zero-copy or copy-on-write escape from the independent-restore memory cost. Duration is a single synchronous measurement, not a responsiveness guarantee. Results do not establish behavior of other engines or large-project resource compliance.
